about: Country cards for lives born in Germany. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Germany (DE) ===================== Ausbildung: the average collectively agreed training allowance was €1,133 a month in 2024 (BIBB press release, 6 Feb 2025): €13,600 a year ÷ 0.688 (PPP) ≈ 0.62 of the game's typical wage, paid while training (as a study with pay). Public universities charge no tuition. The skill gained is a game rule. Choosing it counts as a diploma, so the card at 18 is skipped.

opts.do: done.edu = 'dip'; const lab = M('lbl.ausb'); study = { end: age + 3, gain: 5 * learnLuck('ausb'), pt: .62, label: lab, k: 'dip' }; T('sk_edu', { kind: 'skill', label: lab })

en..x: Instead of the Abitur and university, you could start an Ausbildung: three years of training split between a company and a vocational school, paid an average of €1,133 a month in 2024. Public universities charge no tuition fees.
en..ausb.s: Earn about {a} a year while you train, and finish with a vocational qualification.
en..ausb.h: Skill +5 a year for 3 years; it counts as a diploma.
en..abi.s: Then choose between university, a diploma and work.

zh..x: 除了读文理中学毕业考（Abitur）再上大学，你也可以开始职业培训（Ausbildung）：三年时间在公司和职业学校之间学习，2024年平均每月津贴1,133欧元。公立大学不收学费。
zh..ausb.s: 培训期间每年赚约{a}，结业时拿到职业资格。
zh..abi.s: 之后再选上大学、读文凭或工作。

zht..x: 除了讀文理中學畢業考（Abitur）再上大學，你也可以開始職業培訓（Ausbildung）：三年時間在公司和職業學校之間學習，2024年平均每月津貼1,133歐元。公立大學不收學費。
zht..ausb.s: 培訓期間每年賺約{a}，結業時拿到職業資格。
zht..abi.s: 之後再選上大學、讀文憑或工作。

events.src: BAföG: up to €992 a month from winter 2025/26 for students living away from home, by parents' income; half grant, half interest-free loan, repayment capped at €10,010 and starting five years after the funding ends, usually €130 a month (Studierendenwerke FAQ, Jan 2026). In game money: €992 × 12 ÷ 0.688 ≈ 0.54; the cap ≈ 0.45; €130 a month ≈ 0.07.

let.g: byFam({ poor: .54, working: .38, middle: .15, rich: 0 }) * base

opts.do: T('de_bafog', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_bafog') }); rec('de_bafog', -g, y); later(study.end + 5, 'bafog', { a: Math.min(.5 * g * y, .45 * base) })
T('de_ws', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_ws') }); rec('de_ws', -.3 * base, y); happy -= 2; addSkill('ws', 2, M('trk.de_ws'))

later.bafog: const y = Math.ceil(x.a / (.07 * base)); rec('de_bafog', .07 * base, y)

en..x: BAföG, the state study grant, pays up to €992 a month (from winter 2025/26) if you live away from home, depending on your parents’ income. Half is a grant and half an interest-free loan, and nobody repays more than €10,010.
en..apply.s: About {a} a year while you study. You repay half, interest-free, starting five years after your studies.
en..no: Your parents earn too much for BAföG.
en..work.s: About {a} a year for 20 hours a week. Less free time: Happiness −2.
en..parents.s: They cover your rent and food.

zh..x: 国家助学金BAföG视父母收入而定，不住家里的学生每月最多992欧元（2025/26冬季学期起）。一半是补助、一半是免息贷款，最多只需还10,010欧元。
zh..apply.s: 读书期间每年约{a}。其中一半免息，毕业五年后开始还。
zh..no: 你父母的收入太高，领不到BAföG。
zh..work.s: 每周20小时，每年约{a}。空闲时间少了：幸福感 −2。
zh..parents.s: 他们负担你的房租和伙食。

zht..x: 國家助學金BAföG視父母收入而定，不住家裡的學生每月最多992歐元（2025/26冬季學期起）。一半是補助、一半是免息貸款，最多只需還10,010歐元。
zht..apply.s: 讀書期間每年約{a}。其中一半免息，畢業五年後開始還。
zht..no: 你父母的收入太高，領不到BAföG。
zht..work.s: 每週20小時，每年約{a}。空閒時間少了：幸福感 −2。
zht..parents.s: 他們負擔你的房租和伙食。

events.src: Renting for life: 47.6% of Germans owned their home in 2023, the EU's lowest (Eurostat, via Bundestag research service WD 7-065/24); land transfer tax is 3.5–6.5% by state (finanz.de, 2026), plus notary, land registry and often an agent: about 11% in all.

opts.ok: liq >= .31 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.31 * P), h: MN(liq) })

en..x: About half of Germans rent for life (47.6% owned their home in 2023, the lowest share in the EU), and tenants are well protected. Buying adds about 10–12% on top of the price: land transfer tax of 3.5–6.5%, notary and land registry fees, and often an agent. A family home costs {p}.
en..buy.s: {d} up front (fees included), then {m} a year.
en..etf.s: An ETF savings plan of about {a} a year for 30 years.

zh..x: 大约一半的德国人一辈子租房（2023年住房自有率47.6%，欧盟最低），租客受到很好的保护。买房要在房价外多付约10–12%：3.5–6.5%的房地产转让税、公证和土地登记费，常常还有中介费。一间家庭住房要{p}。
zh..buy.s: 首付{d}（含各项费用），之后每年{m}。

zht..x: 大約一半的德國人一輩子租房（2023年住房自有率47.6%，歐盟最低），租客受到很好的保護。買房要在房價外多付約10–12%：3.5–6.5%的房地產轉讓稅、公證和土地登記費，常常還有中介費。一間家庭住房要{p}。
zht..buy.s: 頭期款{d}（含各項費用），之後每年{m}。
zht..etf.s: ETF定期定額計畫，每年約{a}，投30年。

events.src: Riester: put in 4% of last year's pay to get the full state allowance of €175 a year plus €300 per child born from 2008 (§§ 84–86 EStG). €175 ≈ 0.008 and €300 ≈ 0.014 of the game's typical wage. Fees (about 1.2% a year) are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('riester', { p: .04, until: 66, bonus: bon }, { lock: 62, fee: .012 }, 'trk.riester')

en..x: With a Riester pension, put in 4% of last year’s pay and the state adds €175 a year, plus €300 for each child born since 2008. Riester contracts often charge high fees.
en..riester.s: {a} a year; the state adds {b}. Locked until 62.
en..etf.s: {a} a year, no allowance, no lock.

zh..x: 里斯特养老金：存入上一年收入的4%，国家每年补贴175欧元，2008年以后出生的每个孩子再补300欧元。里斯特合约的手续费常常很高。
zh..etf.s: 每年{a}，没有补贴，也不锁定。

zht..x: 里斯特退休金：存入上一年收入的4%，國家每年補貼175歐元，2008年以後出生的每個孩子再補300歐元。里斯特合約的手續費常常很高。
zht..etf.s: 每年{a}，沒有補貼，也不鎖定。

events.src: Elterngeld: about 65% of net pay (67% below €1,200), €300–1,800 a month, for up to 12 months per parent, 14 if both take part; Elternzeit (unpaid leave) up to three years (BEEG, via HUK and kita.de).

opts.do: const t = T('de_eltern', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_eltern3') }); rec('de_eltern', -.6 * Math.max(0, salary()), 1); offUntil = age + 3; ppM = (ppM || 1) * .85; happy += 4

en..x: After a birth, each parent can take up to three years of Elternzeit. Elterngeld replaces about 65% of take-home pay, up to €1,800 a month, for up to 12 months (14 if both parents take part).
en..year.s: About 65% of your pay for a year. Happiness +3.
en..two: Two months, then back to work
en..two.s: A small dip in pay this year. Happiness +1.
en..three.s: Elterngeld in the first year, then no pay for two. Happiness +4.

zh..x: 孩子出生后，父母每人最多可请三年育儿假（Elternzeit）。父母津贴（Elterngeld）约为税后收入的65%，每月最多1,800欧元，最多12个月（父母都请假可达14个月）。
zh..year.s: 一年领约65%的工资。幸福感 +3。
zh..two: 请两个月，然后回去上班
zh..two.s: 今年收入稍微少一点。幸福感 +1。
zh..three.s: 第一年有父母津贴，之后两年没有收入。幸福感 +4。

zht..x: 孩子出生後，父母每人最多可請三年育兒假（Elternzeit）。父母津貼（Elterngeld）約為稅後收入的65%，每月最多1,800歐元，最多12個月（父母都請假可達14個月）。
zht..year.s: 一年領約65%的薪水。幸福感 +3。
zht..two: 請兩個月，然後回去上班
zht..two.s: 今年收入稍微少一點。幸福感 +1。
zht..three.s: 第一年有父母津貼，之後兩年沒有收入。幸福感 +4。

events.src: Tax returns: of 14.9 million employees assessed for 2021, 86% got a refund, averaging €1,172 (Destatis, via VLH): ≈ 0.053. An average of about 0.045 a year after costs is an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('de_tax', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_tax') }); rec('de_tax', -.045 * B, 25)
T('de_tax', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_tax') }); rec('de_tax', -.035 * B, 25)

en..x: Filing a tax return is optional for most employees, but 86% of those who filed for 2021 got money back, on average €1,172.
en..diy.s: Tax software and an evening each spring: back about {a} a year.
en..help.s: They do it for a yearly fee: back about {a} a year after the fee.

zh..x: 大多数员工可以不报税，但2021年报税的人有86%拿到退税，平均1,172欧元。
zh..diy.s: 报税软件，每年春天花一个晚上：每年退约{a}。
zh..help.s: 他们收年费帮你报：扣掉年费每年退约{a}。

zht..x: 大多數員工可以不報稅，但2021年報稅的人有86%拿到退稅，平均1,172歐元。
zht..diy.s: 報稅軟體，每年春天花一個晚上：每年退約{a}。
zht..help.s: 他們收年費幫你報：扣掉年費每年退約{a}。

events.src: Minijob: earnings up to €556 a month in 2025, free of income tax and of the worker's social contributions (§ 8 SGB IV; the limit follows the minimum wage): €6,672 a year ≈ 0.3; about 0.25 after travel and time, an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('de_mini', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_mini') }); rec('de_mini', -.25 * base, 5, -.5); happy -= 2

en..x: A Minijob on the side: you can earn up to €556 a month (2025) with no income tax or social contributions taken off.
en..yes.s: About {a} a year for evenings and weekends. Happiness −2.
en..yes.h: Health −0.5 a year for five years.

zh..x: 兼一份迷你工作（Minijob）：每月最多可赚556欧元（2025年），不扣所得税和社保。
zh..yes.s: 晚上和周末上班，每年约{a}。幸福感 −2。

zht..x: 兼一份迷你工作（Minijob）：每月最多可賺556歐元（2025年），不扣所得稅和社會保險。
zht..yes.s: 晚上和週末上班，每年約{a}。幸福感 −2。

events.src: Retiring: after 45 insured years, from 65 with no deduction (born 1964 or later, § 38 SGB VI); with 35 years up to four years before 67 with 0.3% less per month (14.4% at 63); each month after 67 adds 0.5% (§ 77 SGB VI) (Deutsche Rentenversicherung rules, as summarised by gegen-hartz.de).

en..x: With 35 insured years you can claim your pension up to four years before the regular age of 67, losing 0.3% for every month early (14.4% at 63). After 45 years you can go at 65 with no deduction. Each month you work past 67 adds 0.5%.
en..63.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..65.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..67.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..70.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.

zh..x: 缴满35年保险，可以在法定的67岁前最多提早四年领养老金，每提前一个月少0.3%（63岁领少14.4%）。缴满45年，65岁就能领且不打折。67岁以后每多工作一个月，增加0.5%。
zh..63.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..65.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..67.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..70.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。

zht..x: 繳滿35年保險，可以在法定的67歲前最多提早四年領退休金，每提前一個月少0.3%（63歲領少14.4%）。繳滿45年，65歲就能領且不打折。67歲以後每多工作一個月，增加0.5%。
zht..63.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..65.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..67.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..70.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
